name: check_emolecules_stock
description: Check whether the leaf starting materials of a proposed retrosynthetic route are present in the eMolecules stock database. The input should be the complete proposed route, not a single molecule. The result stock_ok=true means every predicted leaf material is available, but it does not prove chemical correctness.

answer_route.description: The complete proposed retrosynthetic route as a JSON list of PRODUCT>>PRECURSORS strings.
